methodology: Frozen before scorer execution; derived only from owner-approved categories and synthetic model-blind fixtures.

corrections.change: Four fixed script patterns became equivalent literals. scriptCount previously constructed four dynamic RegExp values over the constant list [Latin, Devanagari, Cyrillic, Greek]; it now tests four literal regexes in the same order. Neither form uses the g flag, so there is no lastIndex state. Scoring behaviour is unchanged.
corrections.equivalenceProof: Old and new scriptCount compared over 21 inputs (empty, single-script Latin/Devanagari/Cyrillic/Greek, multi-script combinations, digits, punctuation, zero-width and control characters, Han, combining forms, and a 5000-character input) plus five repeated calls for lastIndex stability: identical on every case.

originalBytesPreservedIn.note: The parent commit is pushed to origin/integrate/voice-into-audit, so the pre-correction bytes remain permanently retrievable.

corrections.authorization: Authorized historical exception, not silent regeneration. The owner explicitly approved this single recorded correction after the alternative - leaving a live freeze verifier failing - was rejected. No Semgrep rule was suppressed, no ignore entry added and no scan configuration weakened.
